# SYNESIS_E155 — Warning

## Description

SKOS quality "condition" (2).

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: SKOS quality check "condition" — 2 case(s).

  Editorial, not a violation of SKOS: the file was written. Tools such as VocBench (ICV)
  and qSKOS report the same group.
```

## Where it appears

Values the diagnostic carries (what the message names):

- **SkosQualityNotice**: `block`, `condition`, `count`, `examples`
